name: document-systems
description: Compile, validate, gate, render, and verify content-addressed document-system proposals without accepting or executing them.

interface.shortDescription: Governed document models, validation, and views
interface.longDescription: Build immutable proposal Expressions from four bounded document profiles, enforce caller-reviewed semantic invariants, compile portable release packets, and render traceable stakeholder views. The plugin writes nothing and cannot make a document operative or accepted.
defaultPrompt: Model this document need as a proposal-scoped Expression.
Audit this Expression's integrity, semantic invariants, lineage, and evidence boundaries.
Compile a portable human-action release packet from this Expression.
